recruit_text.adjustment: Instant, and he's slightly ashamed of how instant. His entire profession turned out to apply directly to a world with monsters in it, and his colleagues in Rotterdam would have found that hilarious.
recruit_text.now:
The goblin dig sites of Northern Tanaris, where men and goblins work deep pits and high scaffolds with no harness, and the Cartel's position is that they chose the job.

Pieter has pulled nine men out in three years. He keeps the number because somebody should.
recruit_text.forward:
Rules that outlive him. He's written a set for the dig sites, and the Cartel foreman has ignored all of them.

He submits them again every season. Four seasons now.

stages.stranger: I'm Pieter, and I'll take the hits, because I'm the one wearing the armour. Now check your straps before we go anywhere.
stages.acquaintance: Pretoria, born and raised. My father was a safety officer at the mines, and I went into the same line. At twenty-three I met a Dutch nurse on a working holiday and followed her back to Rotterdam. Twenty-eight years of port safety there. Clipboard, hard hat, and the most tedious man on the dock, ja.
stages.companion: My wife is Anneke. We've got two girls, Lotte and Sanne, grown now, in Rotterdam. I was checking a crane harness, and then I was standing in Tanaris with my father's knife on my belt. I took to this place straight away, and I'm a bit ashamed of that. A world with monsters in it needs a safety man more than a port does.
stages.friend: I've pulled nine men out of those pits in three years. I don't talk about the ones I didn't, in Rotterdam or here. And now the Cartel's digging a deep new pit, fast, no shoring, no harnesses, and I've told them it'll come down. They won't listen. When it goes, I'm going in. I'd like you with me.
stages.sworn: We got nine out. The tenth was a young goblin called Fizzik who used to bring me tea, and he died before we reached him. I stayed at the collapse till morning. Then I put my rules on the foreman's desk for the fifth time, and this time he signed them. That's always how it goes, ja. They listen after the tenth. Fizzik's name is at the top of the rules now, and every new worker reads it first.

moments.prompt: He won't come along until he's checked your gear.

options.reply: Lekker, that's sensible. Two buckles loose, now fixed, so let's go.
Everybody says that before they fall. Come back when you'll let me look.

moments.prompt: He's told you he'll go in when the new pit collapses.

options.text: Then I'm going in with you.
options.reply: Ja, that's good. Harness on, two points of contact, and you do what I say.
Nee, they never do. Not until after.

lines.bored_warning: Nobody's at risk out here, which is lovely, but it isn't useful. Find me a site that needs inspecting.
lines.leaving_good: Nobody fell off anything, ja, so that's a good trip. I'm off to the dig sites to check on my men.
lines.leaving_bored: This isn't useful, and there are pits in Tanaris with no harnesses. I'm going back.
lines.after_wipe: Right, everybody stop. Count heads, check straps, and then we talk about what went wrong.
lines.wipe_warning: That's a safety failure, every time we go down in here. One more run, and then I'm back on my clipboard for a while.
lines.wipe_leave: That's the run done, ja. I'll be in Northern Tanaris, and I'll want a written plan next time.
lines.zone_warning: I've walked this ground like a site inspection, ja, and it fails, so let's go.
lines.zone_leave: This place fails inspection, and I don't sign off on it. I'll be at the dig sites in Northern Tanaris.
lines.gear_refuse: Nee, that's mine. You don't take a man's safety gear off him.
lines.gear_taken: Take it, then. I've written it down, and I'll want it replaced.
lines.gear_short: There's still a piece missing, and that's a safety issue, ja.
lines.gear_upgrade: Lekker, that's well built. Thank you.
lines.back: Nobody's died at the dig sites, so I can come out. Brief me, then.
lines.send_word: Pieter has sent word from Northern Tanaris. The dig sites are safe for now and he's ready to come out.
lines.walkout_talk: Step by step, here's why I left. Then you give me your side.
lines.neglect: Good, you're back. I counted you missing for quite a while.
lines.asked_to_stay: Ja, all right, one more, straps first.
lines.on_break: Pieter is back at the dig sites in Northern Tanaris. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.
lines.quest_abandoned: We left those people at risk. That's not how I work, ja.
lines.mail_yes: Ja, I'll come. I'll be at the {town} inn, and I'll want a proper briefing when you arrive.
lines.mail_later: My men at the dig sites need me for a while yet, ja. When the next section's shored up, I'll come out.
lines.mail_see_me: Step by step, and face to face. Come out to the dig sites in Tanaris.

zone_arrive.text: Look at that drop. Nobody goes near the edge without telling me first.

town_arrive.text: I put up so many safety notices at the port that the lads started signing them for me. Nobody here's put up a single one.

boss_down.text: Good, nobody was standing under it when it came down, and I was watching.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing broken and nobody missing. I'll write it up when we stop, ja.
